summary: B57 resolves the fatal-gas planning divergence: all 70 recorded screens and cursors and all 2940 RNG calls match. Cloned losehp preserves HP and killer writes, then hands off before terminal output or done/rehumanize; the live callback owns recovery or final death. Finalized death stops enclosing region/upkeep work, while surviving recovery continues in C order.

source.branch: When region.c:inside_gas_cloud applies damage that is fatal for the hero, the JavaScript elapsed-turn preflight clone reaches losehp. Its live ttyUrgentPline/done effects escape the clone before allmain.c reaches the real run_regions call. C has no speculative callback and emits the region messages in source order.
callers: C: allmain.c:moveloop_core calls nh_timeout then run_regions; region.c:inside_gas_cloud emits stinging/burning-lung messages and calls hack.c:losehp for hero gas damage.

JS: js/unported_monster_actions.js:preflightElapsedTurnTail clones elapsed-turn state and reaches js/allmain.js:finishElapsedTurnAfterTimeout -> js/region.js:inside_gas_cloud -> js/hack.js:losehp before the live callback.
dependencies: The preflight fatal-damage result must be a read-only planning signal; all live tty output, gameover handling, and input prompts remain in the later source-ordered region path.
Audit other preflight callers of losehp to preserve their existing fatal-damage and continuation behavior; do not special-case gas, this case, or its seed.

evidence: The current saved v13 evaluation challenges/evaluations/20260929161024-v13.json reports 69/70 screens and cursors and 2940/2940 RNG for this immutable case; the first mismatch remains segment 0 step 69. C top line contains "You can see again.  Your eyes sting.  Something is burning your lungs!--More--" while JS has "You can see again.--More--".

Upstream allmain.c:moveloop_core orders nh_timeout before run_regions. region.c:inside_gas_cloud prints the eye and lung messages before its damage call. JS preserves that order in the live path, but unported_monster_actions.js preflightElapsedTurnTail speculatively invokes the cloned region path.

Read-only extra-key replay after the immutable input shows JS next printing "You die...--More--", then "Die? [yn] (n)". A further key exposes the stack js/hack.js:losehp -> js/region.js:inside_gas_cloud -> js/allmain.js:finishElapsedTurnAfterTimeout -> js/unported_monster_actions.js:preflightElapsedTurnTail. At HP 4/12, gas damage rnd(dam)+5 is certainly fatal, so the clone reaches losehp and leaks its terminal effects.

Saved v13 evaluation challenges/evaluations/20260929210140-v13.json at 8667be7c87313737e310aa0bdb4f0709d3a77dac passes this unchanged case completely: 70/70 screens and cursors, 2940/2940 RNG. The test-only audit descendant 357779387bfa90a30b84c49fd9bf9b3e82b6f942 leaves all game, scorer and manifest inputs unchanged. Three independent hack.c recordings cover wizard recovery, final death and life-saving.

The full correctness review confirmed one test gap, fixed by an integration test through moveloop_core that rehumanizes a poison-susceptible form and verifies surviving turn continuation. An intentional early return at the planning handoff makes that test fail; the independent adjudicator verified the committed fix. No whole-function source-port completion is claimed by this divergence task.
